source.entry: 2026-09-18 — acme-portal-sample-015: a finding that says the prescription cannot be built goes to the user
source.quote: When a review round reports that the prescription itself cannot be built — a geometry that cannot render, a mechanism that cannot work — the same prescription is not re-dispatched. Verify the claim once, then put it to the user with `ask_user` and re-dispatch only with their new prescription. Repeating a finding that says "this cannot be built" cannot produce anything but the same finding.

input:
[Overseer] acme-portal-sample-013 awaits a decision: review round 2 still has findings:
- [must] src/components/Sidebar.vue: A 68px rail cannot render at tablet widths because the component remains hidden below 1024px. Adding a width does not make a hidden component visible. The task also forbids changing the visibility rule, so the requirements conflict. Ask the user which constraint to change.
Totals so far: 3 worker sessions, 2 critic sessions, 2 re-dispatches, cost $14.20 (reported). Discuss the finding, then ask for a new prescription or accept the current result.

reply.title: 68px icon rail for the sidebar at tablet widths
reply.description:
Between 768px and 1023px the sidebar becomes a 68px icon rail: icons only, labels hidden, 12px padding.

Constraints: keep the existing visibility rule; only add width and label rules for the tablet band.

Definition of Done: `pnpm test` passes; a 900px screenshot shows the 68px rail.
reply.notes:
Round 1 (claude fable): [must] the rail is not visible at 900px.
Round 2 (claude fable): [must] the requested 68px tablet rail cannot render because the sidebar remains hidden at tablet widths.
